目前和平進行，但法國與美國大使館建議國民避開現場，以防暴力。 總統府和天主教主教團（CBCP）發聲呼籲和平，政府承諾調查但未具體承諾。

-- 歷史與政治脈絡，9月21日正值馬科仕獨裁時期結束的「人民力量革命」紀念日，抗議借此象徵性呼籲「結束腐敗、恢復人民力量」。 參與者包括教會團體、公民社會、青年組織（如 Youth Against Kurakot）和大學生，批評現任政府（包括總統小馬科仕）未能解決系統性腐敗。

The public trust has been betrayed for too long. The resources meant to uplift the lives of our citizens have been squandered by those people in power for their personal gain.

This rally is more than a protest. It is our demand for accountability, transparency, and genuine reform. It is a reminder that government officials are stewards of the people’s trust, not beneficiaries of unchecked power. 

We march and raise our voices today not only for ourselves, but for future generations who deserve a Philippines free from systemic abuse and injustice.
